name: methods_by_code_type
note: account.payment.method (addons/account/models/account_payment_method.py): every method keyed by id with the (code, payment_type) natural key the _name_code_unique constraint protects
source_sql: SELECT id, code, payment_type FROM account_payment_method ORDER BY id

name: lines_per_method
note: account.payment.method.line (payment_method_id) embedded as accountPaymentMethod.line: lines per method with the count bound to a journal, as the account.journal payment-method SQL joins them; methods without lines excluded on both sides
source_sql: SELECT payment_method_id, count(*) AS lines, count(journal_id) AS journal_lines FROM account_payment_method_line GROUP BY payment_method_id ORDER BY payment_method_id
